room.description: How a solo practitioner runs the business around the work: four clients' hours, invoices and scope creep on one desk, next quarter's pipeline and a live proposal on another — nothing lost between the inbox, the timesheet and the spreadsheet.

desks.title: Client load this month — hours, scope and invoices
desks.description: Four clients, a retainer running over, a naming job that blew its estimate and an invoice 12 days overdue — the month's work and the month's money in the same view.
desks.brief:
## Client load this month

**Practice** independent content strategist and copywriter, working solo
**Rates** $140 an hour · $1,100 a day · **Month end** @+9d
**Clients** Bluewren Credit Union (retainer) · Magpie Lane Brewing · Bright Lane Childcare · Coolabah Shire Council

### The month in numbers
- $11,510 of work booked across 8 billable jobs
- 66 of 80.5 budgeted billable hours used, with 9 days to go
- $3,000 received · $3,340 invoiced and unpaid · $3,070 to invoice at month end · $2,100 Magpie Lane balance on sign-off

### What needs a decision
- The Bluewren retainer is 1 hour over its 14 — scope creep on the home-loan page (see the note)
- Beer-range naming ran 3 hours over a fixed fee: $100 an hour instead of $140
- **Coolabah's invoice is 12 days overdue**

callout.title: Chase: Coolabah invoice, 12 days overdue
callout.body: $1,100 for the plain-language workshop. Their accounts team needs a purchase order number on every invoice — reissue it with the PO @today, then a polite nudge @+3d if it isn't scheduled for payment. Still nothing after that: a letter of demand.

mindmap.title: Month at a glance — by client

blocks.p: Forty-five minutes on the last working day, before any client work.

ol: Log any missing hours from the calendar — every client call counts
Invoice the Bluewren retainer ($1,960) and any finished fixed-fee jobs
Chase anything more than 7 days past due — Coolabah today, not at month end
Mark paid invoices as paid and reconcile against the bank feed
Move 30% of everything received into the tax account
Check next month's capacity against the pipeline desk

blocks.h4: Rules I set after last quarter

ul: Naming and taglines are quoted at 1.5× my first estimate
A retainer overrun of 2 hours or more gets raised in the month it happens
A deposit before starting any fixed fee over $2,000

notes.title: Scope creep — Bluewren home-loan page
notes.body:
Briefed as one page. It's now the page plus three calculator tooltips and a rate-change disclaimer.

- Page: 8 h logged against 6
- Retainer overall: 15 h against 14

Option A: absorb the extra hour as goodwill and quote the tooltips separately — 3 h, $420.
Option B: fold the tooltips into next month's retainer and say so in writing.

Leaning A. Reply to Farah today.

stickies.title: Today
stickies.body:
1. Reissue Coolabah invoice with the PO
2. Magpie Lane pages 10–11
3. Reply to Farah about the tooltips

stickies.title: Tax
stickies.body: 30% of every payment into the tax account. Received this month: $3,000, so $900 set aside.

desks.title: Next quarter's pipeline — and the proposal that fills it
desks.description: Eleven leads weighted by likelihood, two proposals out and a thin patch two months from now — plus the water-utility proposal that would fill month three, due @+2d.
desks.brief:
## Next quarter's pipeline

**Target** $9,000 billed a month · the Bluewren renewal would cover $1,960 of that for six months
**Pipeline** 11 leads · $27,910 weighted · 2 proposals out, a third due @+2d

### Where work comes from
8 of 11 leads came from past clients or referrals. The newsletter brought one good lead (the museum); social and a cold enquiry brought one each, both early-stage.

### The shape of it
- Work starting next month is covered: $14,604 weighted, most of it the Bluewren renewal
- Work starting in two months is thin: $5,726 weighted
- Month three leans on one lead — without the water utility it is $1,980 weighted

### This week
**Send the water-utility proposal @+2d.** It is the biggest lead in the pipeline and the only thing that fills month three.

callout.title: Next proposal out: water utility, $14,000
callout.body: Due @+2d. A plain-language rewrite of 6 bill and notice templates, in two fixed-fee stages so they can stop after the audit. Rated 40% likely, worth $5,600 weighted — most of what starts in three months.
